title: biblical-studies-books-mining: reproducible K10plus harvesting for a Biblical Studies bibliography
description: Reproducible, resumable extraction of Biblical Studies candidate records from the K10plus union catalogue, with pandas-ready Parquet bibliography. Nine configured searches (DDC 22*, LCC BS*, GND and LCSH subject headings, and English/German/French title supplements) were harvested in full and exported as flat plus machine-readable tables: structured contributors with relator codes, parsed life dates and GND identifiers, and subject concepts merged across the German and English vocabularies. The harvest is not a validated academic corpus but a comprehensive candidate set from a live library catalogue. See EXTRACTION.md for coverage, contributions of each search, and known limitations.
